mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies at 77 degrees with a new moon phase overhead. Tonight will cool down to 67 degrees and there is no rain in the forecast.

The Verona Senior Center is seeking volunteers for various programs and requires a commitment of at least twice a month plus a confidentiality agreement. Additionally, City Hall has posted notices regarding the upcoming partisan primary and general election.

We have a packed schedule with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today. Tomorrow, you can catch the Dane County Farmers' Market, music at Paddy Mac's, or head out to the Cave Carnival.
Looking at the weekly report, on Wednesday, officers responded to a residence on Whalen Road to arrest a 37-year-old man on a probation warrant after he attempted to flee.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. Culver's is open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
